translations.EN: That is just how I am wired.
translations.TL: Ganyan talaga ang pagkakagawa sa akin.

translations.EN: Take me or leave me, that is who I am.
translations.TL: Tanggapin mo man o hindi, 'yan talaga ako.

translations.EN: I have always been like this. It keeps me alive.
translations.TL: Matagal na akong ganito. Nakatulong 'to para mabuhay ako.

translations.EN: Not going to apologize for how I operate.
translations.TL: Hindi ako hihingi ng tawad sa kung paano ako kumilos.

translations.EN: Everyone is built differently out here.
translations.TL: Iba-iba ang hubog ng bawat isa rito.

translations.EN: It is what it is. I am not changing overnight.
translations.TL: Ganoon talaga. Hindi ako magbabago nang biglaan.

translations.EN: That is just my nature.
translations.TL: Kaugalian ko na talaga 'yan.

translations.EN: I am too old to pretend to be someone else.
translations.TL: Masyado na akong matanda para magpanggap na iba.

translations.EN: Like it or not, this is me.
translations.TL: Gusto mo man o hindi, ako ito.

translations.EN: I do things my own way. Has not failed me yet.
translations.TL: Kanya-kanyang diskarte. Hindi pa naman ako binibigo nito.

translations.EN: The world changed. I changed with it.
translations.TL: Nagbago ang mundo. Nagbago rin ako kasabay nito.

translations.EN: You adapt or you end up dead. This is who I had to become.
translations.TL: Makibagay ka o mamamatay ka. Ito ang kinailangan kong kahinatnan.

translations.EN: Survival hardens people. I am no exception.
translations.TL: Nagpapatigas ng loob ang kaligtasan. Hindi ako naiiba roon.

translations.EN: I used to be different before all this fell apart.
translations.TL: Iba ako dati bago gumuho ang lahat ng ito.

translations.EN: You learn to live with who you become out here.
translations.TL: Matututo kang mamuhay kasama ang taong kinahinatnan mo rito.

translations.EN: This world does not leave much room for soft edges.
translations.TL: Walang puwang sa mundong ito ang labis na lambot.

translations.EN: I became what I needed to be to see tomorrow.
translations.TL: Naging kung ano ang kinailangan para makita ang bukas.

translations.EN: We are all shaped by what we had to survive.
translations.TL: Nahubog tayong lahat sa mga pinagdaanan nating hirap.

translations.EN: Hard times make hard survivors.
translations.TL: Ang mahihirap na panahon ay gumagawa ng matitibay na tao.

translations.EN: I did what I had to. It made me who I am now.
translations.TL: Ginawa ko ang kinailangan. Iyon ang bumuo sa akin ngayon.
